## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Baseline structural edits established.

## FINDINGS
A solid heavily-iterated refactor for the About page! While there are still some lingering React imports that should be fully purged in React 17+, the structural edits are well tested. Beware though, PR #161 touches `design-tokens.ts` so expect a minor conflict if you don't merge one of them sooner rather than later.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Approved with Minor Changes
